final_rest.note: The bag stopped on the board and was still there when the clip ended (resting at the lip of the hole).

model_note: Drag-free fit misses the measured path by 9.2 px RMS; predicting the second half from the first half misses by 34.0 px RMS. The bag slows horizontally in the image (12% of its vertical acceleration). Drag and the bag moving away from the camera both cause this; one camera cannot separate them.
